# Plain English Library

> Independent publisher of short, practical PDF guides for working professionals. Current title: The AI-Assisted Agent, a $19, 17-page PDF with five copy-and-paste AI workflows and 25 prompts for real estate agents, with a Fair Housing scan built into every workflow.

## Products
- [The AI-Assisted Agent](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/guides/ai-for-real-estate-agents/): $19 PDF. Workflows for listing descriptions, speed-to-lead and 30-day nurture, consultation prep, a one-hour weekly content engine, and contract-to-close client updates. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any AI chat tool. 14-day money-back guarantee.
- [3 AI Prompts Every Agent Should Use This Week](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/free/): free 5-page PDF.

## Articles
- [A real estate social media content calendar you can use for the next 30 days](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/real-estate-social-media-content-calendar/): Plan a month of real estate social media with 12 post ideas, a weekly schedule, copy-and-paste AI prompts, and a checklist for checking your drafts.
- [Real estate buyer consultation checklist: questions, agenda, and AI prompts](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/real-estate-buyer-consultation-checklist/): Prepare your next buyer meeting with a real estate buyer consultation checklist, 12 questions, a 30-minute agenda, an AI prompt, and a follow-up email.
- [Fair Housing words to avoid in real estate listings, and what to write instead](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/fair-housing-words-to-avoid-in-real-estate-listings/): Which listing words can violate the Fair Housing Act, which common phrases HUD says are fine, and a swap list of safer alternatives. Includes an AI prompt that scans your copy.
- [A ChatGPT listing description prompt that does not invent facts](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/chatgpt-listing-description-prompt/): A two-step ChatGPT prompt for real estate listing descriptions: lock the facts first, then write MLS remarks in your voice, with a Fair Housing check. Works in Claude and Gemini too.
- [Answer new real estate leads in five minutes: follow-up templates by lead source](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/ai-real-estate-lead-follow-up-templates/): First-reply templates for six real estate lead sources, a calm seven-touch follow-up sequence, and an AI prompt that drafts replies in your voice. Copy, paste and personalize.
- [Can real estate agents put client information into ChatGPT? A privacy checklist](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/can-real-estate-agents-use-chatgpt-with-client-information/): What client information agents should never paste into ChatGPT or other AI tools, the settings to change first, and a redaction prompt that keeps drafts useful without exposing clients.
- [How to write a monthly real estate market update with AI, without wrong numbers](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/real-estate-market-update-with-ai/): A step-by-step way to write a monthly real estate market update email or post with ChatGPT: you bring the numbers, AI writes the words. Includes a copy-and-paste prompt, a template and a CAN-SPAM checklist.
- [Open house follow-up texts and emails: templates by visitor type](https://plainenglishlibrary.com/articles/open-house-follow-up-text-and-email-templates/): Copy-and-paste open house follow-up texts and emails for buyers, neighbors, just-looking visitors and buyers who already have an agent, plus a follow-up schedule and an AI prompt that personalizes each message.
